[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. The cracks in the marble floor begin to split wider through the ink-drawn streets, and small green shoots push up out of them. The camera rises slowly at a steady speed in one continuous move as the shoots grow into thick jungle vines and broad leaves that climb the legs of the table, spread across its top and bury the signed papers, a gold crown tumbling off and coming to rest among the leaves, while warm morning light pours in through the tall window. The camera is still rising as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.
